summary.text: Elbridge A. Colby's 2024 X posts highlighted artificial intelligence as potentially decisive in conflict and emphasized military adaptation to AI while cautioning against assuming it will provide a massive offset. His 2024 posts also discussed export controls and semiconductor competition, noting that controls had not yet achieved decisive choke points and that China was advancing in legacy chips. In a 2026 official statement as Under Secretary of War for Policy, the Department of Defense described AI as a critical technology and said frontier AI can improve military capability if it can be acquired and fielded at operational speed. The statement also said the Department is implementing an AI Strategy and updating the 3000.09 policy for lethal autonomous weapons systems.
